svg.text: Task receipt → arrival → geofence (50 m) → before-photo → cleanup → after-photo and confirmation
Phase 2 — Arrival + geofence + before-photo (Set → In Progress)
Geofence check: d <= 50 m and accuracy <= 30 m
Offline: saved to pending_evidence, re-sent on reconnect; server re-verifies
Solid arrow = call / message | Dashed arrow = return / response / UI feedback | Looped arrow = internal step | TX = single atomic database transaction
